plan: A dragonling marksman who gains power with every stack and burns everything in the late game.
aSurveiller: His Q (Super Scorcher Breath). He grows stronger as he stacks: at 225 it executes wounded targets.
contrer: Engage him early: he needs stacks to be strong.
Slow him before his E: it's his only escape.
Avoid his R: his mum heals him if he stands under it.

sorts.P: Gains stacks that empower his spells.
sorts.R: His mum breathes fire in a line.

momentFort: Weak early, very strong in the late game.
